services.name: Fishing Info
services.desc: Morning Flight Charters specializes in providing an exceptional inshore fishing experience aboard our 25′ Steiger Craft, aptly named Bobber Down. Our vessel is meticulously rigged for optimal inshore fishing, featuring outriggers and a carefully curated selection of top-notch rods and reels. Whether you’re targeting a variety of fish species or setting your sights on the “Big Ones,” we’ve got you covered. Bobber Down is not just a fishing vessel; it’s your gateway to comfort on the water. Our boat is fully equipped with a convenient bathroom, ensuring that your fishing trip is not only thrilling but also a comfortable and enjoyable adventure. quotes.author: Jesse Daly
quotes.text: Can’t say enough good things about Captain Steve! I booked a 6 hour charter on our recent trip to Maine. Captain Steve accommodated myself, father in law, brother in law, and nephew. We all caught 2 or more fish. In total we landed 12 stripers and lost 3. It was a great day! He took us to right spots and used the tides to our advantage. We finished the trip by doing some mackerel fishing which my nephew really enjoyed. We’ll definitely be booking with him again the next time we’re in town! Thanks Cap!

quotes.author: Paul Buckley
quotes.text: Absolutely the BEST! I've been sport fishing for about fifty years and fishing with Captain Steve was outstanding. We weren't just fishing, we were catching. We caught 15 large stripers with several keepers. Even the bait fishing was productive and fun! Steve is a great guy, well experienced and fun to be with. This was our second year fishing with Steve and we're looking forward to our next trip!

quotes.author: Michael Gallatin
quotes.text: Captain Steve was absolutely amazing. He was great with our kids and knew exactly where to get the fish. When my family had enough he took us around to see some of the sites and was very knowledgeable about the history. We all had an awesome time. I highly recommend him for anyone who just wants to fish or has a family and wants a more rounded experience.

quotes.author: Scott Pieper
quotes.text: Captain Steve and the Bober Down were on point. We caught tons of mackerel. Then we went Striper hunting. I snagged almost a half dozen within hours of being on board. Captain was very helpful without being overbearing. Had an absolute blast and would do it again.

quotes.author: Mike Ward
quotes.text: Morning Flight Charters was an absolute blast! We caught a ton of large stripers and a few over 40 inches! Captain Steve is very knowledgeable and knows exactly where to go and what to do! Highly recommend this company! Will be back for sure!! Thank you!!!

quotes.author: Jim McClellan
quotes.text: Captain Steve was ready to roll when I got there. Comfortable boat, beautiful ride out, and we were catching fish within minutes of leaving the historic harbor. Wonderful day on the water!
